text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much! Turning a year 
older and turning over a new leaf makes me 
feel like an even more refined Class Rep!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
How do I look? Check out this glossiness! 
Got any proverbs that fit me right now!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? A-A proverb!? Like, breaking out 
of one's shell... umm.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! How about this one? "Grapes are easier 
to peel if you boil them"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oho!? Comparing the current me to a bunch 
of grapes! As expected of someone who 
meets the Class Rep's high standards! 
Though, my cute eyes are actually 
completely unbespectacled!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Boiling represents effort! And grapes bear 
countless fruits...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, through continuous effort 
and shedding one's old skin, one can 
harvest countless fruits of labor, is that 
what you mean to say?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That is truly a wonderful maxim, perfectly 
suited for me! Thank you so much for the 
absolute best present!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(...I felt like that wasn't a profound 
maxim, but just a random cooking tip...)
